Messages.Author: GP41
Messages.Body:
What happens when a Methuselah removes his prey and his prey's prey at
the same?

i.e. Kine resources contested that removes blood enough to get both out
at the same time?

Do my prey gets the 6 bloods? Do he gets a victory point? Do i get 12
bloods and two victory ponts?

This one has been hovering in my head for a while now.

Thx bye!

Messages.Author: tetragr...@my-deja.com
Messages.Body:
In article <38C6D4AB...@videotron.ca>,

GP...@videotron.ca wrote:
> What happens when a Methuselah removes his prey and his prey's prey at
> the same?
>
> i.e. Kine resources contested that removes blood enough to get both
out
> at the same time?
>
> Do my prey gets the 6 bloods?

No, as you can read in the Vtes booklet p.32 (Ending The Game), when a
Predator is ousted in the same turn her prey is ousted,
he (the Predator) gets no blood point...

Do he gets a victory point?

...but, yes, he gets the victory point...

Do i get 12
> bloods and two victory ponts?

...No, you receive 1 victory point and the 6 blood for ousting your
prey. Your prey gets 1 victory point but is ousted as it is
her prey (your grandprey).
As you can see, it's not a great thing to have ousted your grandprey and
your prey at the same moment (or turn), unless there are some life
boon tricks to trigger at the right moment.
Best.
Aemilianus, Prince of Rome.
